education.title: Study in Turkey Guidance
education.intro: Thinking of studying in Turkey? We've been through it. We guide you through choosing programs, applications, scholarships (including Türkiye Bursları) and what to expect once you arrive.
education.feature4: What to expect: arrival, residence, student life

about.title: About us
about.body: We're a small team based in Antalya. One of us works in hotel sales and knows the tourism industry from the inside; the other came to Turkey as a scholarship student and now teaches Turkish. We started this to give international guests something agencies rarely offer: honest, personal, multilingual help — from someone who has actually lived what you're about to do.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What languages do you offer service in?
faq.a1: Turkish, English, Russian, Kazakh and Uzbek.
faq.a2: Guests in Kazakhstan can pay via Kaspi. For all other countries we accept cryptocurrency (USDT, BTC and others). We confirm every payment personally.
faq.a3: By appointment, on Zoom or in person in Antalya, in 15, 30 or 60 minute sessions.
faq.a4: Our bot answers your questions instantly, but a real person handles every booking and payment. You're never left with an automated system.
